_comment: A debug-mode Valkyrie with accessiblemsg on digs north from her room to the top map row with a wished wand of digging, walks up to row 0 and zaps a wished wand of magic missile north. The ray bounces off the map edge and zap.c buzz() prints 'The magic missile hits you!' through pline_dir() toward the square it came from, which lies off the map, so pline.c vpline()'s isok() test leaves the line without a location prefix.
